consumers.DataPage: renders title, HTML description, and View Report when link is truthy. '#' is truthy, so a missing catalog URL still renders View Report to href '#'

consumers.CareerAssistant server: second request to http://localhost:5555/api/search?q={selectedReport}; case-insensitive exact title match; title, description, and link are pasted into the GPT prompt
